title: RBAC v2 Permission Inventory (Working Sheet) — v0.6
summary: Working inventory of sensitive actions across control plane, console backend, support/admin tooling, Dedicated admin, and Private installer flows. Sensitivity rubric: P0=irreversible/high-impact or security-critical (keys, SSO, org deletion, role grants, policy bundle changes, break-glass/impersonation); P1=material impact (billing changes, capacity changes, exports); P2=read-only or low-impact configuration. Current check status reflects staging as of 2025-03-10 (RBAC v2 dual-eval enabled in some services; many endpoints still RBAC v1-only or inconsistent).
notes: Conventions: proposed_action uses <resource>.<verb>.<object> (dot-separated) and should map to RBAC v2 taxonomy (see ENG-5383). scope_hint indicates typical evaluation scope: org / project / deployment / dedicated_pool / system. current_check_status: missing=no consistent authz check; partial=some checks exist but not standardized or missing scope; ok=RBAC v2 check wired + tests. If break_glass_required=yes, normal roles should NOT include the permission; only time-bounded elevated session / support workflow.
